problem:
Consider the vector space ${\text{M}}_{2}(R)$ of all $2\times 2$ matrices over $R.$

Which of the following statements are true?

- ${[\begin{aligned}0 & 0 \\ 3 & 0\end{aligned}],[\begin{aligned}0 & 0 \\ -3 & 0\end{aligned}]}$ is a linearly independent set in ${\text{M}}_{2}(R)$
- $[\begin{aligned}0 & 0 \\ -3 & 0\end{aligned}]$ can be expressed as a linear combination of ${[\begin{aligned}0 & 0 \\ 3 & 0\end{aligned}],[\begin{aligned}0 & 0 \\ -3 & 0\end{aligned}]}$
- ${[\begin{aligned}0 & 0 \\ 3 & 0\end{aligned}],[\begin{aligned}0 & 0 \\ -3 & 0\end{aligned}]}$ is a basis of ${\text{M}}_{2}(R)$
